extra_vocab.en: a check to make sure a person or place is safe
extra_vocab.note: 在這句裡，submit to a security check 是「接受安檢」，語氣正式，常見於公告與規定。
extra_vocab.pattern: N + must submit to + a security check
extra_vocab.grammar_note: submit to 的 to 是介系詞，後面接名詞（a security check），不接原形動詞。

examples.en: Passengers must pass through a security check before boarding the plane.
examples.zh: 乘客登機前必須通過安全檢查。

examples.en: The security check at the main entrance takes about two minutes.
examples.zh: 大門口的安檢大約需要兩分鐘。

examples.en: Please arrive early because the security check may take a long time.
examples.zh: 請提早抵達，因為安檢可能要花很久。

similar.diff: 意思幾乎相同，screening 更常指用機器檢查行李或人員。

example.en: All bags go through security screening before entering the building.
example.zh: 所有包包進入大樓前都要經過安檢。

confusable.diff: safety 指避免意外與危險，security 指防止犯罪與闖入。

example.en: The factory does a safety check on every machine each week.
example.zh: 工廠每週對每一台機器做安全檢查。

extra_vocab.en: a careful check to see if products are good enough
extra_vocab.note: 在這句裡，submit to our quality inspection 是「接受我們的品質檢驗」，用在採購與出貨的規定中。
extra_vocab.pattern: N + must submit to + a quality inspection
extra_vocab.grammar_note: submit to 後面接名詞，to 是介系詞，所以 submit to inspecting 或 submit to inspect 都是錯的。

examples.en: Our team will carry out a quality inspection on the new shipment.
examples.zh: 我們的團隊會對這批新貨進行品質檢驗。

examples.en: The product failed the quality inspection and was sent back to the factory.
examples.zh: 這項產品沒通過品質檢驗，被退回工廠。

examples.en: A quality inspection report must be attached to every export order.
examples.zh: 每一張出口訂單都必須附上品質檢驗報告。

similar.diff: quality control 指整個品管制度，quality inspection 指實際檢驗的動作。

example.en: Our quality control department checks each product before it leaves the factory.
example.zh: 我們的品管部門在產品出廠前檢查每一件。

confusable.diff: quality assurance 是品質保證，重點在事先預防問題；inspection 是事後檢查。

example.en: The quality assurance team created new rules for every production line.
example.zh: 品質保證團隊為每條生產線訂了新規定。

extra_vocab.zh: 權力、權限；官方機構；權威人士
extra_vocab.en: the right to make decisions or give orders
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見「權限」與「政府機關」兩個意思，要靠上下文分辨。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: authority 當「權限」時不可數，後面接 to V（authority to approve）；當「當局」時常用複數 authorities。

example.en: Customs authorities inspect all goods that enter the country.
example.zh: 海關當局會檢查所有入境的貨物。

example.en: Only the manager has the authority to approve this budget.
example.zh: 只有經理有權核准這筆預算。

example.en: The local authorities approved our request to build a parking lot.
example.zh: 地方當局核准了我們興建停車場的申請。

examples.en: Ms. Chen gave her assistant authority to approve small orders.
examples.zh: 陳小姐授權她的助理核准小額訂單。

examples.en: The city authority will announce the new parking rules next week.
examples.zh: 市政單位下週會公布新的停車規定。

confusable.diff: author 是作者，authority 是權力或官方機構，拼法與發音都很像。

example.en: The author of this book teaches business writing at a university.
example.zh: 這本書的作者在大學教商業寫作。

example.en: The board has the power to remove the company president.
example.zh: 董事會有權罷免公司總裁。

example.en: The manager has full control of the project budget.
example.zh: 經理完全掌控專案預算。

example.en: You need written permission to enter the laboratory.
example.zh: 進入實驗室需要書面許可。

derived.link: authority 的字根 + -ize，使成為有權，像 organize

example.en: The director will authorize the purchase of new computers today.
example.zh: 主任今天會批准購買新電腦。

example.en: Only authorized staff may enter the server room.
example.zh: 只有經授權的員工可以進入機房。

example.en: You need written authorization before you can order new equipment.
example.zh: 訂購新設備之前，你需要書面授權。

senses.en: the right to make decisions or give orders

example.en: Ms. Chen has no authority to change the meeting time.
example.zh: 陳小姐無權更改會議時間。

senses.en: a government office that controls something
senses.distinguish: 指機構或單位時通常有 the、tax、local 等字，常用複數。

example.en: The tax authority sent us a notice about late payment.
example.zh: 稅務機關寄給我們一份逾期繳款通知。

senses.en: a person who knows a lot about a subject
senses.distinguish: 後面常接 on + 主題。

example.en: Dr. Wu is an authority on global supply chain management.
example.zh: 吳博士是全球供應鏈管理的權威。

extra_vocab.en: a person who manages a department or a company
extra_vocab.note: 在這句裡 director 是上級主管，經理要每月把報告交給他。

example.en: The directors will meet on Monday to discuss next year's budget.
example.zh: 董事們星期一會開會討論明年的預算。

example.en: The managing director will visit our Singapore office next month.
example.zh: 常務董事下個月會來訪我們的新加坡辦公室。

example.en: The board of directors approved the new marketing plan yesterday.
example.zh: 董事會昨天核准了新的行銷計畫。

example.en: Our sales director is traveling to Taipei this week.
example.zh: 我們的業務主管本週要去台北出差。

examples.en: Please send the budget report to the director by noon.
examples.zh: 請在中午前把預算報告送給主管。

examples.en: I have forwarded your request to the finance director.
examples.zh: 我已經把你的請求轉給財務主管了。

confusable.diff: direct 是形容詞「直接的」或動詞「指導」，director 是名詞，指人。
confusable.usage: direct 可以當形容詞或動詞；director 只能當名詞。

example.en: You can call the sales office on this direct line.
example.zh: 你可以打這支直撥專線給業務辦公室。

confusable.diff: directory 是名錄、通訊錄，不是人。

example.en: The company directory lists every employee's phone number.
example.zh: 公司通訊錄列出每位員工的電話號碼。

example.en: The manager will review all reports on Friday afternoon.
example.zh: 經理星期五下午會審閱所有報告。

example.en: Several executives will attend the meeting in Singapore.
example.zh: 幾位高階主管會出席新加坡的會議。

example.en: My supervisor asked me to update the schedule today.
example.zh: 我的主任要我今天更新時程表。

derived.link: director 去掉 -or，是動詞；director 就是 direct 的人，像 actor

example.en: Please direct all questions to the customer service desk.
example.zh: 請把所有問題交給客服櫃台。

example.en: Follow the direction on the sign to find the meeting room.
example.zh: 依照標示的方向就能找到會議室。

example.en: Look up her extension in the staff directory.
example.zh: 請在員工通訊錄查她的分機。

example.en: Please contact the supplier directly about the delay.
example.zh: 關於延遲，請直接聯絡供應商。

senses.en: a person at a high level who runs a department

example.en: The marketing director approved the new advertising plan today.
example.zh: 行銷主管今天核准了新的廣告計畫。

senses.en: a member of the group that leads a company
senses.distinguish: 常以複數出現，或與 board 連用。

example.en: Two new directors joined the board last month.
example.zh: 兩位新董事上個月加入董事會。

senses.en: a person who guides actors in a film or play
senses.distinguish: 句中常出現 film、movie、commercial 等字。

example.en: The director of the commercial chose a beach in Taiwan.
example.zh: 這支廣告的導演選了台灣的一處海灘。

extra_vocab.note: 在這句裡 newly renovated 是「最近剛翻新的」，newly 修飾後面的過去分詞。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: newly 通常放在過去分詞前（newly hired、newly built），不修飾名詞；修飾名詞要用 new。

example.en: The newly hired employees will attend training on Monday morning.
example.zh: 新進員工星期一早上要參加訓練。

example.en: The newly opened restaurant near our office is always crowded.
example.zh: 我們公司附近新開的餐廳總是很擠。

example.en: The newly appointed manager will introduce herself tomorrow.
example.zh: 新上任的經理明天會自我介紹。

examples.en: We are proud to announce our newly designed website.
examples.zh: 我們很榮幸宣布全新設計的網站上線。

examples.en: The newly promoted director will lead the sales team.
examples.zh: 剛升任的主管將帶領業務團隊。

confusable.diff: new 是形容詞，直接修飾名詞；newly 是副詞，修飾過去分詞。
confusable.usage: new office 正確，newly office 錯誤；newly built office 正確。

example.en: The new office has a large meeting room.
example.zh: 新辦公室有一間大會議室。

confusable.diff: recently 可以修飾各種動詞與時態，newly 主要放在過去分詞前。

example.en: We recently moved our office to a larger building.
example.zh: 我們最近把辦公室搬到比較大的大樓。

similar.diff: freshly 強調剛剛才完成、很新鮮，常用於 freshly painted、freshly baked。

example.en: The freshly painted walls make the office look much brighter.
example.zh: 剛粉刷好的牆讓辦公室看起來亮多了。

example.en: Please send me the latest version of the contract.
example.zh: 請把合約的最新版本寄給我。

example.en: The recent price increase surprised many of our customers.
example.zh: 最近的漲價讓許多客戶很驚訝。

derived.link: re- 再一次 + new，再變新一次，像 return、repeat

example.en: Please renew your membership before the end of this month.
example.zh: 請在本月底前續辦你的會員資格。

example.en: We have good news about the contract with Singapore.
example.zh: 關於新加坡的合約，我們有好消息。

derived.link: new + comer，新來的人，像 comer 是 come 的人

example.en: Newcomers should register at the front desk on arrival.
example.zh: 新來的人抵達時應在櫃台登記。

extra_vocab.en: to have enough chairs for a number of people
extra_vocab.note: 在這句裡 seat 是及物動詞，can seat forty people 表示「可以容納四十人」。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: seat 當「容納」時是及物動詞，後面直接接人數，不加 for，也不用被動：The room seats 40。

example.en: This hall seats about two hundred guests during conferences.
example.zh: 這個大廳在會議期間可容納約兩百位賓客。

example.en: All the seats in the front row are reserved.
example.zh: 前排所有座位都已被預訂。

example.en: The guests were seated at tables near the stage.
example.zh: 賓客被安排坐在舞台附近的桌位。

example.en: The restaurant is seating guests at the window tables now.
example.zh: 餐廳現在正在安排客人坐靠窗的桌位。

example.en: Please take a seat while Ms. Chen finishes her call.
example.zh: 陳小姐講完電話前，請先坐一下。

example.en: I would like to reserve two seats on the morning flight.
example.zh: 我想預訂早班飛機的兩個座位。

example.en: I asked for a window seat on the flight to Singapore.
example.zh: 我要求飛往新加坡的班機坐靠窗座位。

examples.en: Room A can seat about thirty people for the weekly meeting.
examples.zh: A 會議室可容納約三十人參加每週會議。

examples.en: The new restaurant seats fifty guests and offers a private room.
examples.zh: 這家新餐廳可容納五十位客人，並有一間包廂。

confusable.diff: sit 是「坐」，不及物；seat 是「使就座」或「可容納」，及物。
confusable.usage: sit 不接受詞（sit down）；seat 後面要接人或人數。

example.en: Please sit down and wait for the manager.
example.zh: 請坐下等經理。

confusable.diff: set 是「擺放、設定」，和 seat 拼法接近，意思不同。

example.en: Please set the chairs in rows before the meeting starts.
example.zh: 會議開始前，請把椅子排成幾排。

similar.diff: hold 也能表示容納，但不限座位，也可指容納物品或數量。

example.en: This conference room holds up to forty people at once.
example.zh: 這間會議室一次最多可容納四十人。

example.en: Please bring two more chairs into the meeting room.
example.zh: 請再搬兩張椅子到會議室。

example.en: The hall has a capacity of five hundred people.
example.zh: 這個大廳的容納量是五百人。

example.en: The hotel can accommodate up to three hundred guests.
example.zh: 這家飯店最多可容納三百位賓客。

example.en: Please check the seating chart before the dinner begins.
example.zh: 晚宴開始前，請先確認座位表。

example.en: The usher will seat guests before the speech begins.
example.zh: 演講開始前，接待員會引導賓客入座。

example.en: Please keep your seat until the plane stops moving.
example.zh: 飛機完全停妥前，請留在座位上。

senses.en: to have enough chairs for a number of people

example.en: The new auditorium seats about eight hundred visitors.
example.zh: 新的禮堂可容納約八百位訪客。

senses.en: to show someone where to sit
senses.distinguish: 主詞是人（服務生、接待員），受詞也是人。

example.en: The waiter will seat you as soon as a table opens.
example.zh: 一有空桌，服務生就會帶你入座。

senses.en: a position as a member of a group
senses.distinguish: 常見於 board seat、a seat on the committee。

example.en: She won a seat on the board of directors.
example.zh: 她取得了董事會的一個席位。

extra_vocab.note: 在這句裡放在句尾，說明裝修費用加總起來約五萬美元。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: in total 放在數量或句尾，或放句首加逗號；不要寫成 in totally 或 at total。

examples.en: The trip will cost about two thousand dollars in total.
examples.zh: 這趟出差總共約需兩千美元。

examples.en: In total, we received three hundred orders this week.
examples.zh: 本週我們總共收到三百張訂單。

examples.en: In total, twenty-five employees joined the video conference from Singapore.
examples.zh: 總共有二十五位員工從新加坡參加視訊會議。

similar.diff: altogether 意思相同，語氣稍口語，常放在數字後面。

example.en: The three projects cost about ninety thousand dollars altogether.
example.zh: 這三個專案總共約花了九萬美元。

similar.diff: in all 也是「總共」，通常放在數字後面，句子比較短。

example.en: There were eighty visitors in all at the trade fair.
example.zh: 貿易展總共有八十位訪客。

confusable.diff: totally 是「完全地」，修飾形容詞或動詞，不是「總共」。
confusable.usage: totally 是副詞，放在被修飾的字前面；in total 後面不接形容詞。

example.en: I totally agree with your plan for next quarter.
example.zh: 我完全同意你下一季的計畫。

confusable.diff: in short 是「簡言之」，用來做結論，不用來算總數。

example.en: In short, we need more time to finish the report.
example.zh: 簡言之，我們需要更多時間完成報告。

extra_vocab.zh: 停車場；一批；一塊地；很多
extra_vocab.en: an area of land where cars are parked
extra_vocab.note: 在這句裡 back lot 是「後方的停車場」，因為前面的區域施工，所以請大家停在後面。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: a lot of 後面可接可數或不可數名詞；a lot 單獨放句尾當副詞，如 helps a lot。

example.en: All three lots near the office are full this morning.
example.zh: 辦公室附近的三個停車場今天早上都滿了。

example.en: Please leave your car in the parking lot behind the building.
example.zh: 請把車停在大樓後方的停車場。

example.en: We received a lot of calls about the delay.
example.zh: 我們接到很多關於延遲的來電。

example.en: Please write the lot number on the order form.
example.zh: 請把批號寫在訂購單上。

examples.en: The company lot has space for about eighty cars.
examples.zh: 公司的停車場可停約八十輛車。

examples.en: This lot of laptops was shipped from the factory yesterday.
examples.zh: 這一批筆電昨天從工廠出貨了。

confusable.diff: slot 是時段或投幣口，和 lot 只差一個字母。

example.en: Please choose a time slot for your interview.
example.zh: 請為你的面試選一個時段。

confusable.diff: plot 指一小塊地或故事情節；lot 的「一塊地」多指已劃分的土地。

example.en: The company bought a large plot of land for the new factory.
example.zh: 公司買了一大塊地要蓋新工廠。

example.en: We need more space for the new office desks.
example.zh: 我們需要更多空間放新辦公桌。

example.en: The first batch of products will arrive next Monday.
example.zh: 第一批產品下星期一會到。

example.en: Employees may park in the garage under the building.
example.zh: 員工可以把車停在大樓地下的車庫。

example.en: Please park in the lot behind the main building.
example.zh: 請把車停在主建築後方的停車場。

example.en: Sales have improved a lot since last quarter.
example.zh: 自從上一季以來，業績進步了很多。

senses.en: an area of land where cars are parked

example.en: The visitor lot is next to the main entrance.
example.zh: 訪客停車場在正門旁邊。

senses.en: a group of goods made or sold together
senses.distinguish: 後面常接 of + 貨品，或與 number 連用。

example.en: The buyer ordered a lot of five hundred chairs.
example.zh: 買家訂了一批五百張椅子。

example.en: The company bought a lot near the airport for a warehouse.
example.zh: 公司在機場附近買了一塊地蓋倉庫。

senses.distinguish: 常用 lots of 或 a lot of，口語。

example.en: We have lots of time before the meeting starts.
example.zh: 離會議開始還有很多時間。
